description: A site header that renders a navigation menu on wide screens and a fullscreen menu when space runs out.
overview:
`Navbar` builds a `header` from an `items` array. On wide screens it renders a `NavigationMenu`: plain links appear inline, groups open a dropdown of links with optional icons and descriptions, and mega items open multi-column panels. The `brand` sits at the start and `actions` at the end.

The navbar switches to a compact layout below the `48rem` breakpoint, and also on wider screens whenever its contents overflow the header; it measures itself with a `ResizeObserver` and returns to the full menu once there is room again. In the compact layout the items move into a `FullscreenMenu` opened by a menu button, with plain links in the first group and each group or mega column as a labelled section. Use it as the primary navigation of a marketing site or documentation site.
usage: Each `NavbarItem` is one of three shapes: a link with `label` and `href` (plus optional `description`, `icon` and `active`), a group with `label` and `items`, or a mega item with `label` and `columns`. Each column has a `label`, `links` and an optional `featured` flag that sets its links in a large type size. Pass `render` to route links through your framework's link component; it receives `href` and the link content.

examples.WithActions: Adds a Sign in button at the end of the header with `actions`.
examples.LinksOnly: Uses only plain links and marks the current page with `active`.
examples.Crowded: Shows nine links in a narrow frame, folding them into the menu until the frame is wide enough.
examples.WithCloseLabel: Labels the fullscreen menu's close button Done with `closeLabel`.
examples.MegaPanel: Uses `layout="panel"` with a mega item whose columns open in a full-width panel.

parts.Navbar: The header that renders the brand, navigation items and actions.

Navbar.items: The navigation items: links, groups of links, or mega items with columns.
Navbar.brand: Content shown at the start of the header, such as a logo.
Navbar.actions: Content shown at the end of the header, such as a sign-in button; it stays visible in the compact layout.
Navbar.menuLabel: Accessible label of the compact menu button and title of the fullscreen menu.
Navbar.closeLabel: Text for the fullscreen menu's close button.
Navbar.layout: With `popover`, dropdowns float beneath their trigger; with `panel`, they open as a full-width panel anchored to the header.
Navbar.render: The element used for every link, defaulting to a plain anchor; replace it with your router's link component.

accessibility:
- Group and mega triggers are buttons with `aria-expanded` reflecting their state, and `Escape` closes an open dropdown.
- Links marked `active` have `aria-current="page"`.
- In the compact layout, the menu button is labelled by `menuLabel`.
notes: The header carries `data-slot="navbar"`, `data-layout`, and `data-compact` while the fullscreen menu is in use. The brand and actions wrappers use `data-slot="navbar-brand"` and `data-slot="navbar-actions"`, and mega columns use `data-slot="navbar-column"` with `data-featured`. With `layout="panel"` the header gains `relative` positioning and `z-50` so the panel can anchor to it.
